Quarterly operations report — figures as of 31 March 2025

Revenue for the quarter was 4,812,650.75 EUR, up 12.4% from 4,281,717.00 EUR in Q4 2024 and up 31.8% year over year. Recurring revenue made up 3,906,112.40 EUR (81.2% of the total). The average contract value rose from 18,450 to 19,975, while the median stayed flat at 12,000. We closed 241 new contracts out of 1,387 qualified leads, a conversion rate of 17.4%; the previous four quarters were 14.9%, 15.6%, 16.1% and 16.8%.

Costs came to 3,655,904.18 EUR: 2,104,300.00 for salaries (57.6%), 612,480.55 for infrastructure (16.8%), 498,022.10 for marketing (13.6%) and 441,101.53 for everything else. The operating margin was therefore 24.0%, against a target of 22.5%. Cash at the end of the period stood at 9,340,118.92 EUR, enough for roughly 30.6 months at the current burn of 305,000 per month.

Usage. The platform served 1,284,907,332 requests (about 165.2 per second on average, 2,410 at peak on 11 March at 14:05:32 UTC). Median latency was 38 ms, p95 was 212 ms and p99 was 1,045 ms. Availability was 99.982%, which corresponds to 23 minutes 20 seconds of downtime across 90 days; the two incidents lasted 14 min 05 s and 9 min 15 s. Storage grew from 412.6 TB to 468.9 TB (+13.6%), and the largest single tenant now holds 31.4 TB.

Support. 8,416 tickets were opened and 8,502 were closed, so the backlog fell from 391 to 305. First response time improved from 3 h 42 min to 2 h 17 min. Satisfaction was 4.62 out of 5 (n = 2,933), compared with 4.55, 4.49 and 4.58 in the three quarters before. Refunds totalled 27,380.00 EUR over 96 cases, i.e. 285.21 on average.

Headcount went from 148 to 157: 13 hires, 4 departures. Engineering is 71 people (45.2%), sales 29, support 24, operations 18 and finance and administration 15. The ratio of managers to individual contributors is 1 : 7.3.

Key dates: board meeting on 2025-04-17 at 09:30; audit fieldwork from 2025-05-05 to 2025-05-16; the price change takes effect on 01/07/2025. Invoice numbers for the quarter run from INV-2025-000913 to INV-2025-002207. The reference exchange rates used were 1 EUR = 1.0842 USD, 0.8391 GBP and 161.37 JPY.

Measurements from the hardware lab, for the record: the new enclosure weighs 2.35 kg (old: 2.81 kg), measures 310 × 215 × 44 mm, draws 18.5 W idle and 64.0 W under load at 230 V, and stays below 41.5 °C at an ambient temperature of 25 °C. Out of 500 units tested, 3 failed the drop test (0.6%) and 1 failed the 72-hour burn-in (0.2%). Serial numbers 00417, 00418 and 00433 were returned to the supplier. Call +44 20 7946 0958 or +1 (415) 555-0132 with questions.

Forecast for Q2: revenue between 5.0 and 5.3 million, costs near 3.8 million, and headcount of 165 ± 3.
